apiKeyInfo: Enter your parcel.app API key. A Premium subscription is required. Get your key at web.parcelapp.net → API panel.
tooltip_pollInterval: How often to fetch delivery updates (5-60 minutes, default: 10). Rate limit: 20 requests/hour.
tooltip_autoRemoveDelivered: When enabled, delivered packages are automatically removed from the state tree. When disabled, they remain with status 'Delivered' until parcel.app no longer lists them as recent.
aboutInfo: This adapter is free and open source. If you find it useful, please consider supporting its development with a small donation.
descInfoConnection: True while the adapter can reach the parcel.app API.
descCarrier: Display name of the carrier; falls back to the uppercase carrier code when parcel.app knows no name for it.
descStatus: The status as readable text in the ioBroker system language - use statusCode in scripts, it does not change with the language.
descStatusCode: Numeric status from parcel.app (0-8); -1 means the value could not be interpreted.
descDescription: The description you gave the shipment in parcel.app; unlike the device name it always shows the current value.
descExtraInfo: Additional detail the carrier needs, such as a postal code or e-mail address.
descDeliveryWindow: Expected delivery time window; a window spanning several days carries the date on both sides.
descDeliveryEstimate: Expected delivery in words - today, tomorrow, in a number of days or overdue.
descLastEvent: Most recent tracking event reported by the carrier, with its date.
descLastLocation: Where the carrier last scanned the package - not a live position.
descLastUpdated: When the tracking data last changed - not when the adapter last polled.
descActiveCount: Number of packages that have not been delivered yet.
descTodayCount: Number of packages expected to arrive today.
descSummaryDeliveryWindow: Combined window of all packages expected today - earliest start to latest end.
